_readme: Phase 5.5 — Pre-flight Validation Config. Override per-machine in health-check.local.json (gitignored).

scope._environmentsComment: Which environments to run URL reachability checks against

repositories._comment: Checks that config/repos.local.json exists and all configured root paths have a .git folder

catalogManifest._comment: Validates dashboard/catalog-manifest.json is parseable and referenced catalog files exist

specFiles._comment: For every specFiles entry in the catalog manifest, verifies the .ts file exists on disk

authSetupFiles._comment: Checks that .auth storage state files are present and contain non-empty cookies/origins

environmentUrls._comment: HTTP GET against each configured baseUrl — expects 2xx or 3xx (redirect to login is fine)

dashboardServices._comment: require() each service — catches syntax errors, missing dependencies, bad paths

report._comment: JSON reports are written to docs/health-reports/health-{timestamp}.json; oldest are pruned
